info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Disputes-v3-spec
info.description: The Payment Dispute Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about payments that have been disputed. This endpoint provides insights into the specific nature of each dispute, the associated payments, and their current status. Businesses typically utilizing this API include payment processors, financial institutions, and customer service teams aiming to resolve disputes efficiently. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can enhance their dispute resolution processes and improve customer satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of dispute details for payments.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access and retrieve details regarding disputes associated with payments. You can get crucial information about payment disputes, their status, and any related notes that have been added.

requestBody.description: A request body containing parameters necessary to initiate a dispute related to a payment. Ensure the request adheres to the schema specified for a valid submission.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of payment disputes.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operation on the Payments Dispute endpoint in JSON format. It is expected to contain a string value.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesResponse_200.title: Dispute Payment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number assigned to the payment dispute.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the payment dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: The time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the operation.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesResponse_200.description: Response schema for the Dispute Payment operation GET request, indicating the status and details of the dispute processing.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the dispute.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the dispute was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Contains the details regarding the audit trail of the payment dispute operation.
